Measure IQ.evidence_source: Sixteen items, developed as part of the International Cognitive Ability Resource Project (Condon & Revelle, 2014), were used to measure intelligence.

IQ modality.evidence_source: The intelligence measure included four items measuring matrix reasoning (figural), four measuring mental rotations (figural), four dealing with letter series (verbal), and four dealing with overall reasoning (both figural and verbal aspects).

IQ Aspect.evidence_source: The intelligence measure included items for matrix reasoning, mental rotations, letter series, and overall reasoning. 'Overall reasoning' is indicative of general intelligence (g).

Creativity Measures.evidence_source: Inventory of Creative Activities and Achievements (ICAA). To measure creative activity, we used a slightly modified version of the ICAA (Jauk, Benedek, & Neubauer, 2014). Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ). Carson et al.'s (2005) CAQ was used to measure lifetime creative achievements in 10 domains.

Domain classified.evidence_source: ICAA domains: Everyday, Web Development/Programming, Music, Science, Dance, Visual Arts, Writing. CAQ domains: Visual Arts, Music, Dance, Architectural Design, Creative Writing, Humor, Inventions, Scientific Discovery, Theater and Film, Culinary Arts. Mapping these to allowed values: 'Everyday' (from ICAA & CAQ Humor/Culinary Arts), 'Technological' (from ICAA Web Development/Programming & CAQ Inventions), 'Arts' (from ICAA Music/Dance/Visual Arts/Writing & CAQ Visual Arts/Music/Dance/Architectural Design/Creative Writing/Theater and Film), 'Science' (from ICAA Science & CAQ Scientific Discovery).

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the 'Materials' used in a single study, describing various psychological measures. It outlines the K-DOCS, IPIP, CPI and CSE, a 16-item intelligence measure from the International Cognitive Ability Resource Project, a modified Inventory of Creative Activities and Achievements (ICAA), the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), and the Dark Triad Dirty Dozen. The section provides details on the items, scales, and reliabilities for each instrument.
